question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food over the course of days?
premises: This practice has a bodily consequence.
The consequence is described as going to age-death.
inference: By abstaining from food day after day, one will go to death by aging.
uncertainties: the exact sense of vayo mṛtyuṃ in this context is somewhat ambiguous
plain_english: By not eating day after day, one will indeed go to death through the decline of age.
